= FAQ (General) =

== What is PariDroid? ==

PariDroid is a graphical frontend to the PARI computer algebra system on Android devices.

== How can I install PariDroid? ==

Download the latest APK file on this website, copy it to the SD card on your Android device and install with your favorite Android package management application.

Make sure you have enabled "install applications from third party sources" setting on your device.

If you are a developer and have the Android SDK installed on your computer, you can alternatively use the `adb` program to install APKs to your device/emulator.

== Why can't I find PariDroid in the Android Market? ==

PariDroid is beta software and will be available for download in the Android Market when it is stable enough.

== Is !PariDroid open source? ==

Yes, both !PariDroid and PARI/GP are available for free under the terms of the GNU Public License (version 3).

The full text of the license can be found in the top-level directory of the source code.

== Is it possible to run a GP script through !PariDroid? ==

Not yet.

== Do I need root to run PariDroid? ==

No.

== Is it possible to use PARI/GP in the terminal emulator? ==

Yes, but only if your device is rooted.

See UsingPrebuilts for more on how to do this.

----

= FAQ (Development) =

== How do I cross-compile PARI/GP from scratch? ==

See BuildingPariForAndroid (HOW-TO).

== How can I build PariDroid from source? ==

Checkout the source code from this website, run the `configure.sh` and `make_android_toolchain.sh` scripts, then `make all`.

== Which devices has PariDroid been tested on? ==

  * Android Emulator (Android 2.2).
  * Motorola Droid (!CyanogenMod 7.0.3).
  * B&N Nook Color (!CyanogenMod 7.0.3).
  * Samsung Galaxy S (Android 2.3)

= Support =

== I have a question about !PariDroid, ==

The best place to ask questions is on the [https://groups.google.com/forum/?hl=en#!forum/paridroid mailing list].

You can also e-mail the project maintainers directly, but it is better to post to the mailing list for the sake of making !PariDroid development as open as possible. 

== I would like to file a bug report or feature request. ==

You can file a bug report or feature request here: [https://code.google.com/p/paridroid/issues/entry]

== I would like to contribute source code for !PariDroid ==

Great! Here is what you should do.

  # Download the Android SDK/NDK, the source code for PARI/GP and build !PariDroid on your own, install it to a device/emulator and try it out.
  # Join the [https://groups.google.com/forum/?hl=en#!forum/paridroid mailing list] and introduce yourself.
  # Submit a patch (bug fix, new feature) to the mailing list and then you will (most likely) be given commit access to the repository.
  # Write more code (and even more documentation)!
